svg.title: Distinguish a proposed change from an approved one
svg.desc: A conversation can contain several different dates. Check the order and wording before reporting a decision. Proposal. Find the message that suggests a change. Decision. Look for the reply that actually approves it. Summary. Report only the approved detail and keep the message that supports it.
